searchText: Is there an explainer or any kind of documentation on phase 1 specs? <@!689635476826619924> I'm writing phase 1 explainer of the latest phase 1 shard chain spec but the spec itself is still unstable. Although the core shard chain logic still follows V's this docs: https://notes.ethereum.org/@vbuterin/HkiULaluS Yes, would love to read For the proof of custody spec, you can read Dankard's post as a reference: https://ethresear.ch/t/a-0-001-bit-proof-of-custody/7409 Thanks <@!415109946682769408> When are you planning to publish your write up? <@!689635476826619924> yes! but it's currently just some draft notes. I'll find time to finish it after fixing more phase 1 known issues. <@!415109946682769408> I am from Automated Verification team of Consensys. We are planning to start formally verifying phase 1 specs. So, I need to understand at a high-level, the phase 1 specs first. So, it would help me immensely if you can give access to your notes. I don't require the notes to be really polished or anything of that sort. I am also not too bothered about the issues. It is only for my understanding. <@!689635476826619924> DM'd you 🙂
